title: From Spectra to Joint Schedules in LLM Pre-training: 3+3(+2) Scaling-Law Regimes
abstract: arXiv:2609.40148v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Power-law learning curves are often treated as fixed properties of a model and its data, although learning-rate and batch-size schedules can change the observed loss. We study this dependence in noisy online SGD with linear random features. Conditional on the representation, an exact Volterra equation separates two response components: a forcing term that propagates unresolved target error and a memory kernel that propagates stochastic-error injections. We prove that either component follows a power law if and only if its cumulative weighted spectral mass has the corresponding low-spectrum scaling; individual eigenvalues and target coefficients need not obey coordinatewise power laws. Under a joint schedule, intrinsic time $T_t=\sum_{s<t}\eta_s$ controls optimization progress, while $r_t=B_t/\eta_t$ controls noise injection. translated_title: 从谱到LLM预训练中的联合调度：3+3(+2)种标度律区间
translated_abstract: 幂律学习曲线通常被视为模型及其数据的固定属性，尽管学习率和批量大小调度实际上可以改变观测到的损失。我们在带线性随机特征的噪声在线SGD中研究这种依赖关系。在以表示为条件的情况下，一个精确的Volterra方程将响应分离为两个分量：一个传播未解析目标误差的强迫项，以及一个传播随机误差注入的记忆核。我们证明，当且仅当某一分量的累积加权谱质量具有相应的低谱标度时，该分量才遵循幂律；单个特征值和目标系数无需逐坐标地满足幂律。在联合调度下，内在时间 $T_t=\sum_{s<t}\eta_s$ 控制优化进程，而 $r_t=B_t/\eta_t$ 控制噪声注入。二者的相互作用给出了尖锐的条件，用以判断调度在何种情况下会保持、改变或破坏干净的幂律行为。
tldr: 该论文通过带线性随机特征的噪声在线SGD的精确Volterra方程证明，学习率与批量大小的联合调度由内在时间和噪声注入比两个量控制，在累积加权谱质量满足低谱标度的条件下，调度可以保持、改变或破坏损失的幂律，从而归纳出3+3(+2)种标度律区间。
en_tdlr: Through an exact Volterra equation for noisy online SGD with linear random features, the paper shows that joint learning-rate and batch-size schedules—governed by intrinsic time and the noise-injection ratio—can preserve, alter, or destroy power-law loss scaling under low-spectrum mass conditions, yielding 3+3(+2) scaling-law regimes.
